summary.text: Josiah Hill is a Democratic state representative from Minnesota House District 33B who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former English teacher and assistant principal, he holds an Ed.D. in educational leadership.

paragraphs.text: Josiah Hill was born in Davenport, Iowa, and graduated from Stillwater High School in 1995.

He earned a B.A. in English from the University of Wisconsin-Madison in 1999, an M.S.E. in English and language arts from the University of Wisconsin-River Falls in 2001, and an Ed.D. in educational leadership from Hamline University in 2015.
His career experience includes working as an English teacher and assistant principal with Stillwater Area Public Schools, and he has been affiliated with the Education Minnesota union.
Hill assumed office on January 3, 2023, succeeding Kelly Morrison.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Education Policy, Education Finance, and Labor, Industry, Veterans and Military Affairs Finance and Policy committees, and he is co-vice chair of the Education Policy Committee.
